meta.source: design-tokens/tokens.json in zhanglux/lu-x-perience-portfolio. Edit here, then run npm run tokens; the site and this design system are generated from it.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground. Cream in light, near-black brown in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Off-white panel that lifts tables, stats and data off the page.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Full-width bands (the 'What I'm looking for' section, usually at 50%), command output wash.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hover fill for secondary buttons; image wells under cards (at 40%).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Ink. Headings, ALL body copy (paragraphs, sentence-length list items), primary button fill. 14.5:1 on background.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Meta lines, labels, captions, eyebrows, terminal chrome. Never paragraphs. 6.0:1 on background (AA), 4.8:1 on muted.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Terracotta accent for fills, dots, link underlines, focus rings and rules. Light: 3.1:1 on background, so never text and never under cream text; dark ink on it is 5.6:1.

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Terracotta as TEXT: the ❯ prompt, active section link, ▸ bullets. 5.1:1 on background.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a primary-strong fill.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (hovered command button). 5.6:1.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Warm hairline: section dividers, nav rail, command output top rule.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Card borders and band edges (foreground at 10%).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Rules between numbered list rows (foreground at 15%).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button and command button borders (foreground at 20%).

tokens.name: line-hover
tokens.usage: Card border on hover.

tokens.name: dock
tokens.usage: Glass behind the floating command dock, used with a 12px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: output-rule
tokens.usage: 2px left rule under command output.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Warm tint at the end of the gradient behind the hardcover book (secondary → tint).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure white. Only for text and borders on a black scrim over images, and for backdrops behind screenshots that need one.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Pure black. Only as a scrim over images and screenshots (at 40–70%), never as text.

styles.name: 2xs
styles.usage: Micro labels in dense tables and on screenshots.

styles.name: sm
styles.usage: Default UI and case-study copy size.

styles.name: xl
styles.sample: Senior Product Designer who ships code.
styles.usage: Lead line on phones, featured card titles.

styles.name: 2xl
styles.usage: Section headlines on phones, lead line on desktop.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title and hero name. 30px on phones.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: The kind of company I want to help build.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Senior Product Designer who ships code.
styles.usage: The one-line pitch under a display title. 20px on phones.

styles.name: list-lg
styles.sample: A mission-led organisation with strong ethics.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I design AI-powered search and intelligence products, and prototype them in React.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Five years taking search from hand-written Boolean strings to asking a plain question.
styles.usage: Case-study and card copy. Ink (foreground); 28px leading for long reads.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, section labels. Labels take muted-foreground.

styles.name: book-body
styles.sample: We started where search only experts could use.
styles.usage: Running text on the pages of the search case study's book.

styles.name: book-item
styles.usage: Contents rows and lists in the book.

styles.name: book-lede
styles.sample: Customers used to need us to set up their search.
styles.usage: A short lead under a chapter label in the book.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base step; hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, dock padding and gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; output indent.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; list gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter and grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Featured card padding; list column gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero bottom padding; column gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Band padding and column gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Band vertical padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Small marks: checkbox boxes, bar charts, thumbnail frames.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, command buttons and small image frames.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Work cards, stat tiles, content cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The floating command dock and large hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dot, pills, section chips on phones.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Work card on hover, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: A resting lift for data panels such as the A/B results table. Borders come first; use this sparingly.

tracking.note: Letter-spacing. Headings tighten; uppercase labels open up.

tokens.name: tracking-tight
tokens.usage: Display, h2, stat figures and book titles.

tokens.name: tracking-normal
tokens.usage: Resets tracking inside a tightened block.

tokens.name: tracking-wide
tokens.usage: Small all-caps tags.

tokens.name: tracking-eyebrow
tokens.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and rail headings at 11–12px.

tokens.name: tracking-caps
tokens.usage: Uppercase chapter labels in the book.
